summary: Comprehensive testing of DND Timer (dnd_until), Last Seen features, and Bug Fixes for Dashboard/Sidebar navigation. All backend tests (9/9) passed. Frontend UI verified working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: BACKEND API Tests (9/9 passed):
- PUT /api/chat/my-status with dnd_until: Saves timer correctly
- GET /api/chat/my-status: Returns dnd_until field
- DND auto-expire: When dnd_until is in the past, GET resets status to online and clears dnd_until
- PUT with status_mode:'online': Clears dnd_until to null
- GET /api/chat/conversations: Returns other_last_seen for direct chats (empty string if user never connected via WS)
- GET /api/chat/users: Returns users with last_seen field (may be null if never connected via WS)
- DND shortcuts (30min, 1h, 2h): All work correctly with proper timestamps
FRONTEND UI Tests (all verified):
- BUG-FIX: Dashboard pending-reports-widget navigates to /admin?tab=news-moderation - VERIFIED
- BUG-FIX: Sidebar 'Verwaltung' link navigates to /admin?tab=news-moderation when pendingReports > 0 - VERIFIED
- StatusPicker: Shows 3 DND shortcut buttons (data-testid: dnd-30min, dnd-1h, dnd-2h) - VERIFIED
- StatusPicker: Live countdown displayed in trigger label (e.g., 'Nicht stoeren · noch 30 Min') - VERIFIED
- StatusPicker: Clicking DND shortcut closes menu, shows toast, updates trigger label - VERIFIED
- Chat: 'Zuletzt gesehen' code implemented in 3 places (user search, conv list, chat header)
- Chat: StatusDot shows gray hollow circles for offline users - VERIFIED
- Chat: DND banner 'Nicht stoeren aktiv' visible when user is in DND mode - VERIFIED
Note on 'Zuletzt gesehen' display:
- The feature is correctly implemented in ChatPage.js (lines 564, 612, 671)
- It shows 'Zuletzt gesehen vor X Min/Std' for offline users with last_seen timestamp
- Currently most test users don't have last_seen values (only set when connecting/disconnecting via WebSocket)
- This is expected behavior - last_seen is populated when users actually use the chat WebSocket
context_for_next_testing_agent: DND Timer feature fully implemented: (1) PUT /api/chat/my-status accepts dnd_until ISO timestamp; (2) GET /api/chat/my-status returns dnd_until and auto-expires if past; (3) StatusPicker has 3 DND shortcut buttons (30min, 1h, 2h) with live countdown; (4) Last seen feature implemented in ChatPage.js for user search, conversation list, and chat header; (5) Dashboard widget and Sidebar admin link both navigate to /admin?tab=news-moderation when pending reports exist.
